setup: CREATE TABLE an(a INTEGER, b VARCHAR, "yes" INTEGER)  -- observed segments are the result COLUMN NAME, not rows

pins.claim: Operators render as (l op r) with source spellings; NOT-pushed <> renders !=
pins.query: SELECT A + 1 * 2 FROM an  -- observed = cursor.description[0][0]

pins.claim: Function names render LOWERCASED with comma-space args
pins.query: SELECT INSTR(b, 'x') FROM an  -- observed = cursor.description[0][0]

pins.claim: Keyword identifiers render QUOTED (every duckdb_keywords() category - the pinned table in dialect/duckdb_keywords.rs)
pins.query: SELECT yes + 1 FROM an  -- observed = cursor.description[0][0]

pins.claim: Keyword function names render quoted lowercase
pins.query: SELECT REPLACE(b, 'l', '-') FROM an  -- observed = cursor.description[0][0]

pins.claim: trim (the grammar form) renders schema-qualified and quoted
pins.query: SELECT trim(b) FROM an  -- observed = cursor.description[0][0]

pins.claim: CAST renders canonical type names, DECIMAL with a space after the comma; :: becomes CAST
pins.query: SELECT a::DECIMAL(3,1) FROM an  -- observed = cursor.description[0][0]

pins.claim: CASE renders with two spaces after CASE, one extra paren on cond and value, ELSE NULL appended
pins.query: SELECT CASE WHEN a=1 THEN 'x' END FROM an  -- observed = cursor.description[0][0]

pins.claim: Source parens strip; unary minus renders -(e)
Float literals RE-FORMAT (1e3 -> 1000.0) - the frontend refuses auto-naming them rather than reimplement float printing
Boolean literals render as CAST('t' AS BOOLEAN)
pins.query: SELECT true FROM an  -- observed = cursor.description[0][0]
